title: DeepCA: Deep Learning-Based 3D Coronary Artery Tree Reconstruction from Two 2D Non-Simultaneous X-Ray Angiography Projections
record_kind: student-curated digest of primary source; checked by Codex against archived full text
short_verbatim_evidence: we introduce rigid transformations to the CCTA data before performing forward projection on the second projection plane

claims.text: DeepCA以監督式生成模型處理非同時雙投影；訓練資料的運動模擬主要為剛體旋轉與平移。
DeepCA的臨床評估使用二維再投影；這不足以證明任意非剛體補償或三維解剖準確。

boundary: Statements tagged bounded_inference are critical interpretation, not additional author experiments.
